import unittest
from solution import DeviceCatalog


class DeviceCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_constructor_and_locate_deep_copy(self):
        record = {"tag": "alpha", "config": {"ports": [1]}}
        catalog = DeviceCatalog([record])
        record["config"]["ports"].append(2)
        found = catalog.locate("alpha")
        self.assertEqual(found, {"tag": "alpha", "config": {"ports": [1]}})
        found["config"]["ports"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.locate("alpha")["config"]["ports"], [1])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            catalog.locate("missing")

    def test_await_current_does_not_consume_snapshot(self):
        catalog = DeviceCatalog([{"tag": "here"}])
        consumed = []
        def snapshots():
            consumed.append(True)
            yield [{"tag": "later"}]
        self.assertEqual(catalog.await_tag("here", snapshots(), 1), {"tag": "here"})
        self.assertEqual(consumed, [])

    def test_await_replacements_limit_and_state(self):
        catalog = DeviceCatalog([{"tag": "old"}])
        snapshots = iter([[{"tag": "one"}], [{"tag": "target", "data": [1]}], [{"tag": "unused"}]])
        found = catalog.await_tag("target", snapshots, 2)
        self.assertEqual(found, {"tag": "target", "data": [1]})
        found["data"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.locate("target")["data"], [1])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            catalog.locate("old")
        self.assertEqual(next(snapshots), [{"tag": "unused"}])

    def test_zero_checks_and_timeout(self):
        catalog = DeviceCatalog([])
        snapshots = iter([[{"tag": "x"}]])
        with self.assertRaises(TimeoutError):
            catalog.await_tag("x", snapshots, 0)
        self.assertEqual(next(snapshots), [{"tag": "x"}])
        with self.assertRaises(TimeoutError):
            catalog.await_tag("x", [], 3)

    def test_failed_replacement_is_atomic(self):
        catalog = DeviceCatalog([{"tag": "stable", "value": {"x": 1}}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            catalog.await_tag("wanted", [[{"tag": "dup"}, {"tag": "dup"}]], 1)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.locate("stable"), {"tag": "stable", "value": {"x": 1}})

    def test_validation(self):
        for records in ([[{"value": 1}]], [[{"tag": ""}]], [[{"tag": "x"}, {"tag": "x"}]]):
            with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                DeviceCatalog(records)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            DeviceCatalog([{"tag": 1}])
        catalog = DeviceCatalog([])
        for tag in ("", "   "):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                catalog.locate(tag)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            catalog.locate(1)
        for checks in (True, 1.5):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                catalog.await_tag("x", [], checks)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            catalog.await_tag("x", [], -1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
